description: Voice samples: add under consent, delete, read audio.
precondition: User with consent; speech worker replaced.

cases.inputs: actorId: the sample owner; sampleId: an own sample.
cases.return: Success with the profile without that sample (MSG311 "Đã xoá giọng mẫu.").
cases.log: Saved: sample removed; audit row records the deletion.

preconditions: A secretary recorded a sample for the user.
The user reads it on their own voice page.
cases.inputs: actorId: the sample owner; sampleId: a secretary-recorded sample.
cases.return: Success (MSG311); samples a secretary took are the person own too, and theirs to delete.
cases.log: Saved: sample removed; audit row records the deletion with the meeting scope.

preconditions: The sample belongs to another person.
cases.inputs: actorId: a user; sampleId: another person sample.
cases.return: Failure NotFound; someone else sample is answered exactly like one that does not exist.

preconditions: No sample exists for the id.
cases.inputs: actorId: a user; sampleId: an unknown id.
